GOOD QUESTIONS

Before
you go.

A few things to know about owning your route.

Is this a VPN subscription?+

No. Rookstride is a free, open-source Android app for your own VPS. You choose and pay your hosting provider. The app deploys and manages the gateway over SSH; there is no Rookstride cloud account.

Can I keep using the strongSwan app?+

Yes. The administrator can connect inside Rookstride. Invited Android users can import the password-free, certificate-pinned profile into the official strongSwan app and enter their VPN password separately.

Will it remove every ad, including YouTube ads?+

AdGuard Home filters DNS for separate advertising and tracking domains. It cannot reliably remove YouTube in-video ads or ads served from the same domain as the content. Apps using their own encrypted DNS may bypass filtering.

What do I need to install it?+

Android 8 or later, a reachable fresh Ubuntu 24.04 VPS with a public IPv4 address, and administrator SSH access (root or passwordless sudo). The phone needs a network connection; the VPS downloads packages.

Is the current release ready for everyday reliance?+

It is an early alpha. Earlier signed releases passed documented single-server and two-provider reset-and-reinstall cycles. The current app adds persistent installation progress and offline stories with a separate UI test report. Physical-device, network-handoff and sustained-load gates remain. Read the exact test scope.
